entities.summary: Symeon (Simeon) of Polotsk or Symeon Polotsky was an academically-trained Baroque poet, dramatist, churchman, and enlightener of Belarusian descent who came from the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth to the Tsardom of Russia.
